headline: YOU CAN’T HAVE ONE FOOT IN THE GAME AND ONE FOOT OUT AND EXPECT TO MOVE FORWARD! MAN, WHEN
body: YOU CAN’T HAVE ONE FOOT IN THE GAME AND ONE FOOT OUT AND EXPECT TO MOVE FORWARD! MAN, WHEN ARE WE GONNA WAKE UP?! 🏿 At some point, we gotta STOP glorifying the very things that are DESTROYING OUR COMMUNITIES! The street mentality, the unnecessary violence, the jealousy, the hate, the ego, the low-vibrational behavior… IT’S HOLDING US BACK, BRUH! You can’t preach growth while still entertaining destruction. You can’t demand peace while continuing to feed chaos.
